meta.prompt: Show me the flights from London to Lisbon this Friday (20 Nov) as an inline card I can pick from. There are two of us flying, 2 adults, and the prices are per person. Three direct options: TAP Air Portugal 07:15 to 09:50, 2h 35m, £128, tagged Best time; easyJet 11:40 to 14:20, 2h 40m, £84, tagged Cheapest; British Airways 18:05 to 20:40, 2h 35m, £156. The first one is selected to start, the total is for both of us and follows my choice, and the confirm button tells you which flight I chose.
meta.text:
ChatCard "London to Lisbon" "Fri 20 Nov · 2 adults · prices per person" icon:"flight_takeoff" status:"Direct" w:390
  state pick="tap"
  state flights=[{"id":"tap","name":"TAP Air Portugal","depart":"07:15","arrive":"09:50","duration":"2h 35m","price":128,"tag":"Best time"},{"id":"ezy","name":"easyJet","depart":"11:40","arrive":"14:20","duration":"2h 40m","price":84,"tag":"Cheapest"},{"id":"ba","name":"British Airways","depart":"18:05","arrive":"20:40","duration":"2h 35m","price":156,"tag":""}]
  SectionLabel "Direct flights" "per person"
  each f in flights
    FlightOption "{f.name}" depart:"{f.depart}" arrive:"{f.arrive}" origin:"LHR" destination:"LIS" duration:"{f.duration}" stops:"Direct" price:"£{f.price}" tag:"{f.tag}" selected:=pick==f.id -> pick=f.id
  TotalBar "Total for 2 adults" "£{find(flights,x=>x.id==pick).price} per person" amount:="£"+(find(flights,x=>x.id==pick).price*2) cta:"Confirm" -> emit confirm find(flights,x=>x.id==pick).name
